title: Romania's Double Crisis: Political Deadlock Deepens an Already Painful… · 15 Oct
keywords: Romania, political crisis, government formation, Luca Niculescu, PSD, PNL, USR, UDMR, inflation, recession, GDP contraction, National Bank of Romania, fiscal consolidation, EU eastern flank, cost of living, stagflation, IMF, World Bank
notes: Romania has spent more than five months without a functioning government, cycling through four failed prime-ministerial candidates while its economy contracts and inflation remains well above comfortable levels. The combination of political paralysis and a deteriorating growth outlook is placing mounting pressure on households, investors and Romania's standing inside the European Union. The country's ability to manage its fiscal obligations and implement EU-funded programmes is now openly in question.
